# Aunt Jamesina & Roy Gardner

- [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) — Friend of — [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) — likes him very much and thinks he is the nicest young man she ever knew · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) before going for a walk in the park to clear her head. During a sudden downpour, her umbrella breaks and she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who shares his umbrella with her. After walking her home, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a box of roses, prompting teaseful remarks from [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wonders if she has met her ideal prince.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P1](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0001), [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 ch.Charming P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042)_

> While dressing for a reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), which secretly disquiets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) arrives to escort [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the event, where she spots [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Christine across the room and compares herself to her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Christine P20](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0020)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher accepted her sketch, bringing excitement to Patty's Place. While on a walk, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) announces his mother and sisters will visit, unnerving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Roy's family arrives a day early on Friday, creating chaos, but the awkward visit ends with Roy's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) bonding with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P31](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0031)_

> As the girls pack to leave Patty's Place after graduation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) proposes to her in romantic fashion, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suddenly realizes she does not love him and refuses his proposal. She returns home shaken and confesses the rejection to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who eventually forgives and comforts her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Dawn P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 ch.Dawn P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 ch.Dawn P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)_
